386: ## 2026-11-01 S1894: D5 large-image input on the actual curve E'/F' (S1720)
387: 
388: - Question: prove the SL_2 large-image input S1725ImageContainsSL2 l for the
389:   actual S1720 curve E'/F' (equivalently the D5 clause SourceTorsionClause l
390:   over that curve), or pin the exact first missing.
391: - Result: MISSING, with the gap now exactly reduced and machine-checked.
392:   S1725 had already built the paper's Definition 3.1(c) clause for E'/F'
393:   conditionally on S1725ImageContainsSL2 l.  S1894 proves:
394:   (i) SL_2(F_l) is literally det.ker inside GL_2(F_l) (S1894SL2_eq_detKer);
395:   (ii) a change of rank-two basis conjugates the matrix representation, hence
396:   the containment SL_2 <= im rho_{l,b} is independent of the basis, for an
397:   arbitrary actual punctured elliptic curve (S1894GenImageTail_congr), so the
398:   "exists a basis" quantifier carries no extra content;
399:   (iii) S1725ImageContainsSL2 l <-> S1725RankTwoBasisGap l AND the basis-free
400:   large-image input S1894LargeImageInput l (S1894ImageContainsSL2_iff);
401:   (iv) the first missing input is literally the tree's frozen
402:   SerreStyleLargeImageStatement E' l (S1894ExactMissing_iff_serre).
403:   The basis component is therefore only the known open rank-two freeness card
404:   (equivalently finrank (ZMod l) E'[l] = 2 once finiteness is known,
405:   S1894RankTwoBasisGap_iff_finrank), not a second independent gap.
406: - Unchanged arithmetic side, all unconditional for E'/F' and re-exported in
407:   S1894: Torsion23Rational E' (S1721/S1724); mu_6 carrier with primitive-root
408:   label and cardinality 6 (S1725); l-coprimality at the selected bad place for
409:   every l >= 5 (place above 7 when l = 5, above 5 otherwise, S1725); split
410:   multiplicative reduction (S1720); the representation is surjective onto its
411:   range by construction.  Consequently the l = 5 residue-characteristic
412:   selection problem of the S1687 interface does not occur at the S1720/S1725
413:   interface: S1725SourceTorsionClause needs only the image input.
414: - What is still missing (no fake, no axiom, no True slot): the Serre-style
415:   large-image statement for the actual mod-l image of E'/F', plus rank-two
416:   freeness of E'[l].  A grep over the whole tree shows
417:   SerreStyleLargeImageStatement and RankTwoTorsionBasisGap occur only as
418:   definitions and docstrings, never as a proved conclusion; hence none of the
419:   available arithmetic inputs (nine-point injection, odd residue, split
420:   reduction, torsion base change, degree bound) yields the image statement,
421:   which is open-image content absent from Mathlib.
422: - S1894SourceTorsionClause reconstructs the paper's D5 record for E'/F' with
423:   its image field set to the basis-free condition, so the clause exposes
424:   exactly what the paper supplies; S1894LargeImageInput_of_clause shows that
425:   any clause with that image field really carries the input.

## 2026-11-01 S1894: D5 large-image input on the actual curve E'/F' (S1720)
- Question: prove the SL_2 large-image input S1725ImageContainsSL2 l for the
actual S1720 curve E'/F' (equivalently the D5 clause SourceTorsionClause l
over that curve), or pin the exact first missing.
- Result: MISSING, with the gap now exactly reduced and machine-checked.
S1725 had already built the paper's Definition 3.1(c) clause for E'/F'
conditionally on S1725ImageContainsSL2 l.  S1894 proves:
(i) SL_2(F_l) is literally det.ker inside GL_2(F_l) (S1894SL2_eq_detKer);
(ii) a change of rank-two basis conjugates the matrix representation, hence
the containment SL_2 <= im rho_{l,b} is independent of the basis, for an
arbitrary actual punctured elliptic curve (S1894GenImageTail_congr), so the
"exists a basis" quantifier carries no extra content;
(iii) S1725ImageContainsSL2 l <-> S1725RankTwoBasisGap l AND the basis-free
large-image input S1894LargeImageInput l (S1894ImageContainsSL2_iff);
(iv) the first missing input is literally the tree's frozen
SerreStyleLargeImageStatement E' l (S1894ExactMissing_iff_serre).
The basis component is therefore only the known open rank-two freeness card
(equivalently finrank (ZMod l) E'[l] = 2 once finiteness is known,
S1894RankTwoBasisGap_iff_finrank), not a second independent gap.
- Unchanged arithmetic side, all unconditional for E'/F' and re-exported in
S1894: Torsion23Rational E' (S1721/S1724); mu_6 carrier with primitive-root
label and cardinality 6 (S1725); l-coprimality at the selected bad place for
every l >= 5 (place above 7 when l = 5, above 5 otherwise, S1725); split
multiplicative reduction (S1720); the representation is surjective onto its
range by construction.  Consequently the l = 5 residue-characteristic
selection problem of the S1687 interface does not occur at the S1720/S1725
interface: S1725SourceTorsionClause needs only the image input.
- What is still missing (no fake, no axiom, no True slot): the Serre-style
large-image statement for the actual mod-l image of E'/F', plus rank-two
freeness of E'[l].  A grep over the whole tree shows
SerreStyleLargeImageStatement and RankTwoTorsionBasisGap occur only as
definitions and docstrings, never as a proved conclusion; hence none of the
available arithmetic inputs (nine-point injection, odd residue, split
reduction, torsion base change, degree bound) yields the image statement,
which is open-image content absent from Mathlib.
